items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: So his manager, Knowles, they used to call him, told him, -- said, 'Well, he's going to start tomorrow.'

ctx.x: And they wanted him to play at the Strand Theatre. I told him no, he wasn't going to play the Strand. I was going to play the Strand Theatre. So his manager, Knowles, they used to call him, told him, -- said, 'Well, he's going to start tomorrow.' I said, 'If he's going to start tomorrow, he's going to have to whip me, and you, too.'

And Basie heard him, and Basie called him in there and told him, said, "He's going to finish this Strand Theatre. Now, you all want him to start over in the Royal Roost, okay, he starts after this job here." So I finished the Strand. And he came in the Royal Roost.
